```{r}
#install necessary packages

install.packages("nflverse")
library("nflverse")
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(naniar)
library(ggplot2)
```

#this block is just code to copy so we have the same type of process when combining data & look at my creating columns block in case you want to use those columns aswell  

```{r}

#this is how u grab your division & change to fit your division
my_division <- c("BAL", "CLE", "CIN", "PIT")

#put the code below in your block & modify it to work for your division
clean_schedule <- load_schedules(2018:2022) %>%
  filter(
    location == "Home",
    game_type == "REG", #excludes neutral sites
    home_team %in% my_division | away_team %in% my_division
  ) %>%
  select(game_id, season, home_team, away_team, home_score, away_score, result, location, roof)

#this function will take a while to load 
my_pbp <-load_pbp(2018:2022) %>%
  filter(
    game_id %in% clean_schedule$game_id, #matches the function so we can join them
    !is.na(play_type)
  )%>%
  select(game_id, posteam_type, epa, penalty, penalty_type, penalty_team, 
    penalty_yards, pass_attempt, rush_attempt, yards_gained, 
    play_type, down, ydstogo, qtr, score_differential) 
#i added more variables to give more options incase you want to check dif variable correlation

division_df<- clean_pbp %>% left_join(clean_schedule, by="game_id")

```


Reuel's block
```{r}

reuel_division <- c("BAL", "CLE", "CIN", "PIT")

clean_schedule <- load_schedules(2018:2022) %>%
  filter(
    location == "Home",
    game_type == "REG", #excludes neutral sites
    home_team %in% reuel_division | away_team %in% reuel_division
  ) %>%
  select(game_id, season, home_team, away_team, home_score, away_score, result, location, roof)

my_pbp <-load_pbp(2018:2022) %>%
  filter(
    game_id %in% clean_schedule$game_id, #matches the function so we can join them
    !is.na(play_type)
  )%>%
  select(game_id, posteam_type, epa, penalty, penalty_type, penalty_team, 
    penalty_yards, pass_attempt, rush_attempt, yards_gained, 
    play_type, down, ydstogo, qtr, score_differential) 

division_df<- my_pbp %>% left_join(clean_schedule, by="game_id")
head(division_df)

#handling missing data
gg_miss_var(division_df)
division_df$penalty_yards <- replace_na(division_df$penalty_yards, 0)
```

#Creating new columns
```{r}
division_df <- division_df %>% 
  mutate(
    penalized_side = case_when(
      penalty_team == home_team ~ "Home",
      penalty_team == away_team ~ "Away",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ #keeps na values as NA values
    )
  )

division_df <- division_df %>%
  mutate(
    is_indoor = case_when(
      roof %in% c("dome", "closed") ~ 1,
      roof %in% c("outdoors","open") ~ 0
    )
  )

division_df <- division_df %>%
  mutate(
    is_covid_year = case_when(
      season == 2020 ~ 1, #covid year
      TRUE ~ 0 #every other year
    )
  )

#the first penalty type affects the home team more than the ref
#the second penalty type affects the refs calls
division_df <- division_df %>%
  mutate(
    penalty_category = case_when(
      is.na(penalty_type) ~ NA_character_,
      str_detect(penalty_type, "False Start|Delay of Game|Illegal Formation|Illegal Shift") ~ "Procedural (Crowd Noise)",
      str_detect(penalty_type, "Holding|Pass Interference|Roughing|Unnecessary Roughness|Face Mask|Horse Collar|Unsportsmanlike") ~ "Discretionary (Ref Judgment)",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

#check to see if data is sorted properly
table(division_df$is_covid_year, useNA = "ifany")
table(division_df$penalized_side, useNA = "ifany")
table(division_df$penalty_category, useNA = "ifany")

```

#Analyzing AFC North data

```{r}
game_df <- division_df %>%
  group_by(game_id, season, is_covid_year) %>%
  summarise(
    home_penalties = sum(penalized_side == "Home", na.rm = TRUE),
    away_penalties = sum(penalized_side == "Away", na.rm = TRUE),
    
    home_discretionary = sum(penalized_side == "Home" & str_detect(penalty_category, "Discretionary"), na.rm = TRUE),
    away_discretionary = sum(penalized_side == "Away" & str_detect(penalty_category, "Discretionary"), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    home_procedural = sum(penalized_side == "Home" & str_detect(penalty_category, "Procedural"), na.rm = TRUE),
    away_procedural = sum(penalized_side == "Away" & str_detect(penalty_category, "Procedural"), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% #We calculate (Away - Home) so that POS numbers mean the Away team got more penalties.
  mutate(
    total_diff_pen = away_penalties - home_penalties,
    total_diff_disc = away_discretionary - home_discretionary,
    total_diff_proc = away_procedural - home_procedural
  )

penalty_df <- game_df %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_disc_diff = mean(total_diff_disc, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_proc_diff = mean(total_diff_proc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

penalty_long <- penalty_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("avg_"),
    names_to = "penalty_type",
    values_to = "net_diff"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    penalty_type = ifelse(
      penalty_type == "avg_disc_diff",
      "Discretionary (Ref Judgment)",
      "Procedural (Crowd Noise)"
    )
  )

ggplot(penalty_long, aes(x = season, y = net_diff, color = penalty_type, group = penalty_type)) +
  # Dashed zero line (above 0 = Away team penalized more; below 0 = Home team penalized more)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  # Vertical marker highlighting the 2020 empty-stadium season
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2020, linetype = "dotted", color = "firebrick", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Away-Minus-Home Penalty Margin Across NFL Seasons (2018–2022)",
    subtitle = "Values above 0 mean Visiting Teams were penalized more (Red dotted line = 2020 Empty Stadiums)",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Average Net Penalty Margin (Away - Home)",
    color = "Penalty Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

covid_game_df <- game_df %>%
  mutate(
    stadium_env = factor(
      ifelse(is_covid_year == 1, "2020\n(Empty Stadiums)", "Normal Years\n(Packed Stadiums)"),
      levels = c("Normal Years\n(Packed Stadiums)", "2020\n(Empty Stadiums)")
    )
  )

ggplot(covid_game_df, aes(x = stadium_env, y = total_diff_disc, fill = stadium_env)) +
  # Dashed zero line (0 = completely even penalties between Home and Away)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.9) +
  # Boxplot showing median and middle 50% of games
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, width = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA) +
  # Individual game dots so you can see the actual sample size and spread
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.75, color = "#1e293b") +
  labs(
    title = "Game-by-Game Discretionary Penalty Margin: Packed vs. Empty Stadiums",
    subtitle = "Each dot represents one game (Values > 0 mean the Away team had more judgment calls)",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Net Discretionary Penalty Margin (Away - Home)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```
#linear regression
```{r}

# Tests if away-minus-home judgment calls dropped significantly in 2020
model_disc <- lm(total_diff_disc ~ is_covid_year, data = game_df)
summary(model_disc)


# Tests if false starts / delay-of-game margins dropped when stadiums were silent
model_proc <- lm(total_diff_proc ~ is_covid_year, data = game_df)
summary(model_proc)

#(All Fouls Combined vs. COVID Empty Stadiums)
model_total <- lm(total_diff_pen ~ is_covid_year, data = game_df)
summary(model_total)

#Controlling for Stadium Roof Type + Total Game Penalty Volume
model_combo <- lm(total_diff_disc ~ is_covid_year + total_diff_proc, data = game_df)
summary(model_combo)

```
